title: Backgammon
short_description: Calm, classic 3D backgammon — carved checkers on a warm wooden board, real two-dice rolls, hitting to the bar, and bearing off to win.
description: A cozy, unhurried game of backgammon rendered in clean 3D. The full standard ruleset: race your fifteen checkers around the board on real two-dice rolls (doubles give you four moves), leave a lone blot and it can be hit and sent to the bar to re-enter, and once all your checkers are home, bear them off to win. Play a thoughtful AI across four skill levels on a warm walnut-and-ivory board under soft light, with gentle piano. Click a checker, then a highlighted point to move.
controls_keyboard: Left-click a checker to select · click a highlighted point to move · dice roll automatically each turn · Right-drag rotate camera · scroll zoom · Esc pause · F3 debug
